title: Original property/label names starting with a digit break CREATE PROPERTY GRAPH
evidence: G3 bundle: 05_property_graph.sql rejected by Spanner: "Syntax error on line 6, column 56: Expecting EOF but found an unknown character (\`)" -> position is the alias `1st` in PROPERTIES (id_1st AS `1st`). Spanner DDL does not accept a quoted identifier that starts with a digit, but the tool preserves original Neo4j property names verbatim as graph property names. Isolated by probes: labels containing " ; -- are all accepted.
workaround: column_renames does not help (the original name is always used as the graph property name); rename the property in Neo4j before export

title: A single rejected row makes the Dataflow load hang (no invalidOutputPath); oversized values not detected
evidence: R2 nodes Dataflow job 2026-11-18_18_15_03-12830543361029124285 loaded 23/24 VStr rows; the row with a 10,380,918-char string (STRING(MAX) limit is 2,621,440 characters) was rejected by Spanner. The runbook does not pass `invalidOutputPath`, so the template's 'Write failed Spanner records' step tried to finalize into the worker-local filesystem and spent >45 min in LocalFileSystem.match/File.isDirectory (stack in Cloud Logging, 'Operation ongoing in bundle ...Finalize'). workaround: Remove/trim values > 2,621,440 chars (STRING) / 10 MiB (BYTES) before export; set a GCS invalidOutputPath by editing the template parameters
